main_points: Proposed automation system for converting PDFs to PowerPoint presentations.
Supports large documents and maintains brand control.
User-friendly interface for uploading PDFs and customizing presentations.
important_facts: Output remains editable in PowerPoint, avoiding Google Slides due to font issues.
Workflow involves uploading, text extraction, summarization, and slide outline creation.
Template library JSON dictates slide selection and content formatting.
data_points: Default target slide count is ten, adjustable based on content.
First slide requires a generated hero image with specific layout requirements.
potential_slide_messages: Automate your PDF to PPT conversion with our streamlined system.
Maintain brand integrity while reducing manual effort.
Easily upload and customize your presentations.
risks_or_missing_context: Dependence on Google Drive for storage and processing.
Potential challenges in accurately summarizing complex PDF content.
Need for clear guidelines on template usage and image generation.
